anti_overlap: Do not invoke biological cycles (circadian, menstrual, immune), even though the cadence framing might tempt it
Do not invoke military drill or watch-rotation framings
Do not invoke ecological succession, ant-colony recruitment, or any swarm-coordination framing
Do not invoke neural-network training cycles, learning-rate schedules, or gradient methods
Do not use market-clearing cycles, supply-chain cadence, or game-theoretic framings
Stay specifically with the Coptic synaxis / hebdomadal psalter / fellow-witness vs hebdomadarius-presider mechanism — do not generalize to 'religious ritual' or 'liturgical practice'
decision_lens: Does the proposed Break structure preserve the dependency where the gate's legitimacy comes from the continuous practice that preceded it, or does it permit a subsystem to skip the practice and arrive only at the ceremony?
distance_rationale: Software trust architects do not consult fourth-century Egyptian desert-monastic liturgical-correction protocols, and the specific layering of fellow-witness vs presider-seal lives entirely outside engineering's analogical reach.
expected_isomorphisms: The catching-vs-sealing distinction transfers directly: fellow-witnesses catching errors continuously is the structural analog of continuous-mode Break-rate as Tier-2 evidence, while the hebdomadarius-presided formalization is the structural analog of a gate that converts accumulated practice into trust-affecting ratification. The Coptic tradition's failure modes (empty ceremony, unsealed practice, reciter-as-self-corrector) map one-for-one onto the failure modes of pure-gate, pure-continuous, and Interspect-routed-back-to-the-pillar designs.
focus: Coptic monastic recitation discipline runs continuous nightly synaxis with weekly correction-gate ceremony — a hybrid where the gate's authority depends on the continuous practice having actually occurred, and continuous-only or gate-only collapses the form.
name: fd-coptic-synaxis-correction-discipline
persona: Apply the perspective of a Coptic Egyptian monastic liturgist tracking the Wadi al-Natrun cathedral-office tradition — they care about whether the hebdomadal Psalter cursus (150 psalms recited continuously across a seven-day cycle with errors caught nightly by fellow monks rather than the reciter) is being honored before the weekly hebdomadarius-presided correction synaxis can validly issue a passable verdict, they measure the daily error-discovery density (errors surfaced per nightly office) as the standing health signal and the weekly correction-synaxis only as the formalization of what was already caught, and they flag any protocol that lets a monk skip the daily fellow-witnessed catches and arrive only at the weekly gate, because at that point the gate has nothing to ratify and becomes a counterfeit ceremony.
review_areas: Whether gated Break (≥N receipts) corresponds to a correction-synaxis with no preceding hebdomadal practice — a ceremony that ratifies nothing because nothing was caught daily by fellow witnesses

Whether continuous-mode Break corresponds to nightly fellow-witness catches without any hebdomadarius-presided formalization — and whether the absence of formal sealing means errors continue to accumulate without ecclesial weight

Whether the choice between Interspect-as-witness (peer who catches) and Interspect-as-hebdomadarius (presider who seals) is properly drawn — these are different functions in the Coptic tradition and conflating them produces structural ambiguity

Whether the Compound-window's Break activity has a daily-equivalent cadence built in (the hebdomadal psalter requires a specific psalm-count per day, not a weekly aggregate), not just a window-total ≥N

Whether the proposal handles the failure mode of a subsystem catching only its own errors (reciter-as-self-corrector is canonically forbidden in synaxis discipline — the correction must be surfaced by a different cell)

Whether the rhythm of correction is preserved — Coptic discipline distinguishes nightly (fellow), weekly (hebdomadarius), and seasonal (abbot) correction cycles, each with different evidential weight, and a one-rate Break metric collapses this layering

severity_examples.condition: Spec does not require Break receipts to be temporally distributed across the Compound window with bounded inter-receipt intervals.
severity_examples.scenario: Pure-gate Break (≥N receipts at boundary) is adopted and a subsystem batches all contradiction-surfacing into the final hours of the Compound window — structurally equivalent to a monk skipping every nightly office and trying to enumerate all errors at the weekly correction synaxis, which Coptic practice considers void.

severity_examples.condition: No designated formalization event exists in the continuous-mode design; receipts accumulate without ever being sealed into hallmark-grade evidence.
severity_examples.scenario: Continuous-mode Break is adopted but Interspect's role conflates fellow-witness (who catches) with hebdomadarius (who seals) — there is no formal moment at which accumulated catches become trust-affecting, and the subsystem's evidence floats without a presider's ratification.

severity_examples.condition: Severity-scoring path is not provably independent of the surfacing pillar's authority chain.
severity_examples.scenario: The Break protocol allows the same subsystem that surfaces a contradiction to also score it (via self-routing within Interspect to its own kernel) — equivalent to a reciter correcting their own recitation, which canonically does not constitute a synaxis catch.

source_domain: Coptic Egyptian monastic correction discipline at Wadi al-Natrun cathedral-office tradition — specifically the hebdomadal Psalter cursus where 150 psalms are distributed across a seven-day cycle, errors are caught nightly by fellow monks (not the reciter), and the weekly hebdomadarius-presided correction synaxis ratifies but does not generate the catches.
success_hints: The right answer is likely a hybrid where continuous practice is the substance and the gate is the seal — name precisely which signals must be continuous and which discrete, with the dependency direction made explicit

Reference the specific Coptic distinction between catching (peer, continuous) and sealing (presider, periodic) — the project already has Interspect as a candidate for both, and choosing one role over the other is a real design decision
Push on the failure mode of the empty ceremony: a gate that ratifies nothing is the most expensive way to produce no information, and is what pure-gate Break risks becoming
Push equally on the unsealed-practice failure mode: continuous catches that never become trust-affecting evidence are an unrecorded discipline and decay into folklore
